agentCan: Implement either token flow (legacy or OAuth 2.1) including PKCE and refresh-token rotation
Advise the minimal scope set and prepare the marketplace review packet (listing, demo link, how-to page)

approval.cost: No listing fee stated in the docs read
approval.trigger: No review before real users can connect: promote a version to live, share the install link, and anyone can install. Unlisted apps show a banner that 'the monday.com team hasn't vetted them'. Marketplace listing is an optional four-phase review (listing guidelines + review checklist + submission form) assessing product, engineering, security, privacy, content, assets, support, documentation, and legal, iterated over a shared monday board.
approval.wait: Marketplace: initial response within 72 business hours of submission (stated); total duration explicitly variable and unstated

blockers.detail: The legacy flow issues non-expiring access tokens with no refresh tokens via /oauth2/token. The newer OAuth 2.1 flow (opt-in toggle per app version) uses a different endpoint (/oauth_ms/oauth/token), expiring tokens, rotating refresh tokens, and mandatory PKCE (S256 only). Picking wrong means rebuilding your token layer.
blockers.howToClear: New integrations should choose OAuth 2.1; if you inherit a legacy app, monday provides a token migration endpoint (rate-limited).
blockers.title: Two token regimes: legacy vs OAuth 2.1

blockers.detail: What you request at authorize time must match the scopes configured in the app's OAuth tab; asking for more fails. Scopes are set per app version, and only a promoted live version serves real users.
blockers.howToClear: Finalize scopes in the OAuth tab and promote the version before sharing install links.
blockers.title: Requested scopes must match the configured list

blockers.detail: Two documented disqualifiers: any app that uses a user's global API token 'will not be approved for our marketplace', and new apps built primarily with no-code platforms or AI-generated 'vibe code' are not eligible. Duplicates of existing marketplace apps or apps without clear unique value may also be declined.
blockers.howToClear: Build on OAuth from the start and articulate unique value in the submission; do not rely on listing if your app is a thin clone.
blockers.title: Marketplace eligibility traps

flavor.recommended: A monday app in the Developer Center using the standard OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow; choose the newer OAuth 2.1 flow for new builds
flavor.why: Monday explicitly recommends OAuth when your app 'needs to make API calls in the background or upload files' or calls 'without user input'. OAuth 2.1 adds expiring access tokens, refresh tokens, revocation, and mandatory PKCE; the legacy flow issues non-expiring tokens with no refresh at all.

humanMust: Create the app in the Developer Center (monday account required)
Configure scopes and redirect URLs in the OAuth tab; retrieve and vault the client secret
Promote the app version to live
Accept developer terms before sharing an install link
name: Monday.com
nuances: OAuth 2.1 refresh rotation: every refresh returns a NEW refresh token; 'always store the latest refresh token and discard the old one'.
A user in several monday accounts picks one at authorize time; you can preselect via the account slug subdomain or the subdomain= parameter.
force_install_if_needed gives a seamless flow: users without the app installed are sent to install first (an admin installs), then returned to OAuth.
New marketplace apps 'must be monetized by monday' per the review checklist documentation, and must supply a demo link, support contact, and an embeddable how-to page.
There is an RFC 8414 discovery endpoint and a token migration endpoint (429 means wait 5 minutes) for moving legacy app tokens to 2.1.
prerequisites: Scope list (22 documented scopes in read/write pairs)
For OAuth 2.1: PKCE support in your client

steps.detail: In the monday UI: profile picture > Developers > create an app. The client_id and client_secret live in the app's Basic Information tab.
steps.title: Create the app in the Developer Center

steps.detail: In the app's OAuth tab (OAuth & Permissions in 2.1), set the permission scopes (e.g. boards:read, boards:write; 22 documented scopes) and redirect URLs. For new apps, turn on the 'New OAuth Flow' toggle to opt into OAuth 2.1. What you request later must match this list exactly.
steps.title: Configure OAuth: scopes, redirects, flow choice

steps.detail: Copy client_id and client_secret from Basic Information into your backend vault.
steps.title: Copy the credentials

steps.detail: In the App versions tab, promote your version to live. Only a live version serves real users; draft versions are testable by collaborators via app_version_id.
steps.title: Promote the app version to live

steps.detail: Redirect users to auth.monday.com/oauth2/authorize (client_id, redirect_uri, optional space-separated scope, state). The returned code is valid 10 minutes. Exchange it at the token endpoint for your flow (legacy /oauth2/token or 2.1 /oauth_ms/oauth/token) with client_id, client_secret, code, redirect_uri. Legacy: non-expiring access token, no refresh. OAuth 2.1: PKCE (S256) required; store the rotating refresh token's latest value every time.
steps.title: Implement the flow

steps.detail: Install tab for your own account; Share tab (after accepting developer terms) for a public install link, optionally restricted to specific accounts. Unlisted apps carry the 'not vetted' banner.
steps.title: Distribute via the install link

steps.detail: (Optional) Complete the listing guidelines and review checklist, then submit via the Submission form in the Submit app tab. Expect an initial response within 72 business hours (stated); iteration happens on a shared monday board.
steps.time: Packet prep ~half a day; review variable
steps.title: (Optional) Submit to the marketplace

tagline: Standard OAuth with one real design fork: the legacy flow hands out non-expiring tokens with no refresh, while the newer OAuth 2.1 flow adds expiry, rotating refresh tokens, and mandatory PKCE. No review stands between you and users.

time.active: ~20 min of app configuration + ~1-2 hrs of flow code
time.total: Same day to users installing via your share link; marketplace listing adds a review of unstated total length
time.waiting: None to distribute; marketplace initial response within 72 business hours (stated)
